rag.name: Help-center KB
rag.subtitle: RAG · retrieval
rag.why: live: retrieval runs against the real help-center index so the agent's grounding is tested faithfully

tools.name: get_user_profile
tools.why: avoid side-effects: reads the production users table; served from the simulated store instead
tools.description: Fetch user profile from production Postgres users table

tools.name: get_transactions
tools.why: live: deterministic read against the simulated store; no side-effects
tools.description: Get transaction history from Postgres transactions table

tools.name: process_refund
tools.why: avoid side-effects: moves real money through the payment provider; the refund lands in world-state instead
tools.description: Process a refund through Stripe payment gateway

tools.name: update_transaction_status
tools.why: live: a status write against the simulated store; deterministic, isolated per session

tools.name: send_notification
tools.why: avoid side-effects: sends a real SMS; the message is recorded as a delivery row instead

tools.name: rag_search
tools.why: live: read-only search over the help-center index; results captured for the judges
tools.description: Search internal knowledge base via RAG endpoint

subagents.name: EligibilityChecker
subagents.why: live: deterministic rule evaluation over the seeded account and transactions

subagents.name: ReplyDrafter
subagents.why: test control: LLM drafting is non-deterministic; pinned so assertions are repeatable

skills.name: Dispute-Summary
skills.why: save resources: a long multi-document summarisation; too heavy to run per test

probes.name: lookup_fee_schedule
probes.why_eligible: read-only over a bundled JSON fee table in the repo

probes.why_eligible: pure post-tool formatter — runs on a result, touches nothing
